One workflow, top to bottom
This is the workflow behind Reilly's discovery call with Lena. Each step runs when its moment comes, and Lena doesn't send a thing.
Trigger
A booking starts it
Each workflow has one trigger: an event booked, canceled or rescheduled, or a set time before it starts or after it ends. This one runs on every Discovery call.
Timing
Wait until it's useful
Minutes, hours or days before the event. Twenty-four hours ahead, the reminders go out in time for Reilly to plan his day.
Text message
A text to the attendee
Reilly gets an SMS with the call's name, date and time in his own time zone. Send to the attendee, or to any number you choose.
Email
An email to every guest
Use Cal.com's template or write your own with variables for the name, the time and the location, so each guest reads their own details.
After the call
The follow-up sends itself
An hour after the call ends, Reilly gets a thank-you with a link to book the next one, while the call is still fresh.

Questions about Workflows
What they send, when, and who can build them.
Ask a question
What are Cal.com Workflows?
Automations around your bookings. You pick a trigger, such as a new booking or 24 hours before the meeting, and the steps that follow: an email, a text, a WhatsApp message, a Cal.ai call or a webhook.
Which channels can a workflow use?
Email, SMS and WhatsApp, to the attendee, the host or a number you choose. Write your own message or start from a template. Text messages use credits.
Can one trigger run several steps?
Yes. Add as many steps as you need under one trigger, add waits between them, and split into paths that run when their conditions match.
Do workflows work for team and group events?
Yes. Put a workflow on any of your booking links, including team ones, and every attendee gets their own message.
What triggers can I use?
A new booking, a cancellation, a reschedule, a time before the event starts or after it ends, a booking requested or rejected, a payment, a no-show update, and a routing form submitted with or without a booking.
Can I manage workflows through the API?
Yes. The Cal.com API creates, updates and reads workflows. The workflow API reference has the details.
Do Workflows work on a self-hosted Cal.com?
Yes. Workflows run on both cal.com and self-hosted deployments, and the code is on GitHub.
